main.description: Make a domain the primary of one of the caller's instances: a verified custom domain that is serving, or the platform subdomain. The instance restarts onto it. Customers only.

hostname.description: The verified custom domain, or the instance's own <slug>.hpy.at.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per intended change and resends on every retry of it, so a retry gets the original reply instead of acting twice.

jobId.description: The background job following the switch, when there was one. Absent when the hostname was already the requested primary. Poll it with at.happyproto.server.getJob.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: instanceId or idempotencyKey is not a UUID, or hostname is missing or too long.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such instance or domain, or it is not the caller's. The cases are indistinguishable.

errors.name: NotAvailable
errors.description: Custom domains are not switched on yet.

errors.name: InvalidSlug
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: SlugTaken
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: NotEntitled
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: InstanceLimit
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: NoCapacity
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: OperationInProgress
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: the instance is already changing, or a request with this idempotencyKey is still running.

errors.name: InvalidHostname
errors.description: The hostname is not a valid public hostname: no scheme, port, path, wildcard or IP address.

errors.name: PlatformHostname
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: DomainExists
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: DomainLimit
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: TooSoon
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: DomainIsPrimary
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: NotVerified
errors.description: The hostname is not a verified domain of this instance: still pending, lapsed, or about to lapse.

errors.name: CertificateNotReady
errors.description: The domain's certificate isn't issued yet, or the instance is stopped, so the domain isn't serving over HTTPS.

errors.name: VersionTooOld
errors.description: The instance runs a HappyView too old to switch its primary domain safely. Update the instance first.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers, or the job could not be started.
